BiblicalUsage: Sibraim is a place on the northern border of the promised land, named once in Ezekiel's vision of the borders. It stands between Hamath and Damascus, on the line God draws for the restored land. The name is a boundary marker in a prophecy of return.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sibraim matters because God draws the borders of His people's future, and no part of the promise is left vague.
